notes:
Lead: VP Product (Anika Roy). Mid-market B2B SaaS — multi-tenant analytics platform for customer support workflows. Evaluating hosted first to validate latency/quality, then Dedicated for predictable throughput and data isolation.

POC scope: integrate chat endpoints into support console (agent assist + auto-summaries) + periodic reranking for search results. Expected traffic pattern: bursty during business hours, avg 45k requests/day, peaks ~10x.

Key constraints/asks:
- Must support SSO/SAML + SCIM (security requires single sign-on + user sync).
- Data residency: customer data in us-east only for initial rollouts.
- Retention controls: want 30d ephemeral KV cache and option to disable logging for PII flows.

Latency & throughput targets:
- Interactive chat token-latency target ~200-300ms p95 for assistant responses (aiming for snappy agent flows).
- Reranking: throughput target 1k/sec at 50ms per doc ranking step (batching expected).

Cost sensitivity: High. CFO wants unit economics before committing to Dedicated. Initial ask: TCO at 100k/month active users, and expected cost per 1M tokens for hosted vs dedicated. Goal: reduce per-token cost by 3x with Dedicated + quantization & batching.

Cost optimization workshop notes (2/28 call with Maya + Infra team):
- Workshop agenda drafted: workload characterization, batching profiles, prefix/KV caching, quantization tradeoffs, unit-econ model. (See drive agenda.)
- Initial simulation: enabling KV caching for 30% prefix hit expected to reduce token spend ~18%.
- Quantization profiles: se suggested int8 for embeddings and int4 for decoding in Dedicated POC to hit cost targets; Ironwood wants quality baseline tests (ROUGE/semantic embedding drift) before switching.
- Batching: dynamic batching acceptable for reranking; strict latency SLO for chat so set max batch window 15ms.

POC plan & milestones:
- Week 0 (3/15): kickoff + cost workshop (hosted API telemetry ingestion).
- Week 1: integrate SDK, send sample traffic, collect token distribution, latency histogram.
- Week 2: run targeted optimization experiments (cache hits, batch sizes, quant profiles).
- Week 3: present TCO + quality/regression report + Dedicated configuration recommendation.

Recent activity timeline: see timeline field for discrete entries.

Customer quotes / paraphrases: "If we can hit a 3x reduction in inference cost without material quality loss we'll move to Dedicated." — Anika (VP Product).

Sales notes: pricing sensitivity — CFO prefers capex-like predictable monthly commit for Dedicated; AE to model 12 vs 24 month commit scenarios. SE to validate model variants and fallback policies for graceful degradation.

Open items: share SOC2 report (security), confirm egress rules for VPC peering, provide example eval scripts for quality checks (embedding drift).
